title: Essential Chat
description: Customizable HUD and chat tweaks — coordinates, FPS, clock, ping, direction, armor display, chat highlights, and message stacking. All toggleable.
body:
![main  title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bda9077fd83b4cbefa08c50c3a0a792b90cca971.png)

**A clean HUD & chat mod for Minecraft 1.21.1.**
A slick info HUD, smart chat features, and a live armor display — all toggleable.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📊 Info HUD
Toggle exactly what you want to see:
- 🕐 **Real Clock** — your real-world time
- 🌙 **MC Clock** — in-game time (Day / Sunset / Night / Sunrise)
- 🎯 **FPS** — color-coded performance
- 🌍 **Coordinates** — X / Y / Z
- 🌳 **Biome** — current biome name
- 📶 **Ping** — your latency, color-coded
- 🧭 **Direction** — N / S / E / W facing
- 📅 **Day Counter** — days survived
- 🖱️ **CPS** — clicks per second (left & right)
- ⚡ **Speed** — blocks per second
- 🛠️ **Item Durability** — held item's remaining durability

### ❤️ Armor Display
- See your **4 armor pieces** and their durability next to the hotbar
- ⚠️ **Low-armor warning** — alerts you when a piece drops below 10%

### 💬 Chat Features
- 🔔 **Chat Highlight** — get alerted when someone says your name
- 📚 **Message Stacking** — repeated messages merge into one with a `(x2)` counter
- 🎬 **Chat Animation** — smooth slide + fade as messages appear
- 🧹 **Clear Chat** — wipe your chat in one click
### Chat Animation Preview:
![animaiton](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c05c6e4b31d0385777b33b0185e420d3380dcee.gif)
---

## ⌨️ Keybinds
- **O** — open the menu
- **H** — toggle the HUD
- **N** — copy the last chat message
- **J** — copy your coordinates
- **Delete** — clear chat

*(All rebindable in Minecraft's Controls settings.)*

---

## 📦 Requirements
- **Minecraft 1.21.1**
- **Fabric Loader** + **Fabric API**

> Built for **1.21.1 only** — please use the matching version.
